title: Custom domains
adminsOnly: Only admins and owners can manage custom domains.

list.title: Your domains
list.intro: Guests who open your own domain land on your join page. Staff and admin pages always stay on our address. Posters switch to your domain once it is verified.

records.intro: Add these two records at your DNS provider, then press Check now. DNS changes can take a while to spread.

verify.unavailable: We could not reach the DNS lookup service. Try again in a minute.

remove.title: Remove {{host}}?
remove.description: Guests who open this address will no longer reach your join page. Posters already printed with it stop working until you add it again.

errors.invalid_input: That is not a domain we can use. Use a full name such as book.yourshop.com, not an IP address and not one of ours.
errors.domain_taken: That domain is already in use.
errors.permission_denied: Only admins and owners can add domains.
